paragraphs: Elkana a farm bought with one desire only, to make you feel as an owner of a peace of land in Namiba.

The self-catering luxury lodge was build with a purpose to make your stay an once in a lifetime experience. During your stay, the entire property is yours alone—no other guests and no on-site staff—allowing for complete privacy and an authentic, uninterrupted escape into nature.

Planning your grocery shopping, knowing that you will have to plan for the next few days without the opportunity to quickly run to the store will give you the authentic feeling of how Namibian Farmers have to plan there once in a week grocery shopping. A little tip from our side, don't forget to buy your sundowner drink. The lodge is fully equipped with everything you need, including a fridge, oven, crockery, cutlery, glassware, wine glasses, as well as a pizza oven and outdoor barbecue area, ensuring stress free cooking whilst enjoying a breath taking few.

Elkana holds different Namibia antelopes, additionally giraffes and abundant birdlife that can be observed from the comfort of your terrace as an nearby waterhole offers the opportunity for wildlife to gather around. Or cool of in the swimming pool with breath-taking view over the open planes of the farm.
Remember to keep the doors closed, all sliding dores have extra goose dors that will help to keep the insects and oser small wildlife out and the fress air in.

For your own comfort, please keep all doors closed. All sliding doors are fitted with additional gauze doors, that will keep insects and small wildlife out while you can still enjoy the fresh breeze coming in.
A visite on Elkana Farm is a rare opertunity to feel at home, far away from home.

values.title: Nature & Wildlife
values.description: Free-roaming wildlife and breathtaking sunsets, Namibia's untamed wilderness is right at your doorstep.

values.title: Sustainability
values.description: Solar power, water conservation, and locally sourced materials ensure our luxury treads lightly on this precious landscape.

values.title: Privacy
values.description: As an exclusive-use lodge, Farm Elkana is entirely yours during your stay — no shared spaces, no strangers.
